meta.build_type: release (cargo --release: opt-level 3, lto fat, codegen-units 1, panic abort)

extension.note: no git repository; source hash = sha256 over engines/duckdb/{Cargo.toml,Cargo.lock,src/*.rs}

pinning.note: logical CPUs 0-15 = 8 P-cores x 2 SMT; 16-31 = E-cores

load_before.require_quiet_message: [quiet] REFUSING to record timings: cpu 28.8% busy (limit 15%), gpu 0% (limit 20%).

load_after.note: load average is recorded for information only; the gate is instantaneous CPU and GPU use
